gen-dafont-cowboys-fs-quicksand: Quicksand reads soft and rounded, its tall lowercase bowls puffed like blown glass, against Cowboys with its wide-gapped stems. Give the sans a touch more size than you'd expect.
gen-dafont-cowboys-fs-recia: Cowboys traces each letter in one constant-width line, rustic and sure. Recia, a serif with light modulation you notice only up close and generous openings at every weight, gives that outline a sharper partner.
gen-dafont-cowboys-fs-roundo: Rough-hewn and rustic up top, Cowboys leaves wide gaps between its stems. And Roundo keeps every small counter unclogged, so a long run of text moves along smoothly.
gen-dafont-cowboys-fs-sentient: Sentient is a contemporary serif with pinched apertures and crossbars a touch thinner than its stems, set under Cowboys' neon-tube strokes. Glass-tube weight against fine hairlines is the whole story.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-biorhyme: BioRhyme reads bookish and refined, its curves ending like brush strokes lifted early and its capitals spaced generously wide. Cowboys adds rustic, thick-jointed weight on top, and the body lets it speak.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-orbit: Rustic Cowboys lettering meets Orbit, whose curves stop short and whose characters float apart with rope-like consistency. Text moves in light, separate steps rather than a dense block.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-sanchez: Sanchez is bookish and dignified, with a c opened like a pair of calipers. Sanchez adds only slight stroke contrast beneath Cowboys, whose lines never shift from heavy to light, and that gap is the pairing.
gen-dafont-cowboys-source-serif-4: Source Serif 4 is dignified, with a gaping c opening. Under Cowboys' rope-fine strokes, its slightly thinner hairlines and tightened curve tops let paragraph after paragraph move along steadily.
gen-dafont-crust-clean-poppins: Poppins is modern and sturdy, with tall, loose-flowing curves. Crust Clean packs its tall round forms nearly shut, so the open Poppins letters give the heading room to breathe.
gen-dafont-disorder-fs-ranade: Disorder scatters its big lowercase glyphs well apart in a flat fineliner line. And Ranade, with its slightly stretched-rubber weight and far-apart stroke ends, gives that rawness a spread-out, organic foil.
